def VTask.setValue {α : Sort u_1} {β : Sort u_2} (f : α ↪ β) (a : α) (b : β) 
    [∀ (a' : α), Decidable (a' = a)] [∀ (a' : α), Decidable (f a' = b)] : α ↪ β := by
  have h₁ : ∀ (a' : α), Decidable (a' = a) := by
    intro a'
    exact inferInstance
  have h₂ : ∀ (a' : α), Decidable (f a' = b) := by
    intro a'
    exact inferInstance
  classical
  -- We use the classical approach to handle the decidability instances
  have h₃ : ∃ (a' : α), f a' = b ∨ ∀ (a' : α), f a' ≠ b := by
    by_cases h : ∃ (a' : α), f a' = b
    · exact ⟨Classical.choose h, Or.inl (Classical.choose_spec h)⟩
    · exact ⟨a, Or.inr (by simpa using h)⟩
  -- We consider two cases: whether there exists an a' such that f a' = b or not
  cases h₃ with
  | intro a' h₄ =>
    cases h₄ with
    | inl h₄ =>
      -- Case 1: There exists an a' such that f a' = b
      -- We need to construct a new embedding that swaps the values of a and a'
      have h₅ : a' = a ∨ a' ≠ a := by by_cases h₅ : a' = a <;> [exact Or.inl h₅; exact Or.inr h₅]
      cases h₅ with
      | inl h₅ =>
        -- Subcase 1.1: a' = a
        -- If a' = a, then f a = b, and we do not need to change anything
        exact ⟨fun x => f x, by
          -- We need to show that the new function is injective
          intro x y h₆
          have h₇ : f x = f y := by simpa using h₆
          exact f.injective h₇⟩
      | inr h₅ =>
        -- Subcase 1.2: a' ≠ a
        -- We need to construct a new embedding that swaps the values of a and a'
        have h₆ : a' ≠ a := h₅
        have h₇ : f a' = b := h₄
        -- Define the new function
        let g : α → β := fun x => if x = a then b else if x = a' then f a else f x
        -- Show that g is injective
        have h₈ : Function.Injective g := by
          intro x y h₉
          by_cases h₁₀ : x = a
          · by_cases h₁₁ : y = a
            · -- Case: x = a and y = a
              simp_all
            · -- Case: x = a and y ≠ a
              have h₁₂ : g x = b := by simp [h₁₀]
              have h₁₃ : g y = if y = a' then f a else f y := by
                simp [h₁₁]
                <;> aesop
              have h₁₄ : (if y = a' then f a else f y) = b := by
                simp_all [h₁₂]
                <;> aesop
              by_cases h₁₅ : y = a'
              · -- Subcase: y = a'
                have h₁₆ : f a = b := by simp_all
                simp_all [h₁₅]
                <;> aesop
              · -- Subcase: y ≠ a'
                have h₁₆ : f y = b := by simp_all [h₁₅]
                have h₁₇ : f y = f a := by simp_all
                have h₁₈ : y = a := by
                  apply f.injective
                  simp_all
                simp_all
          · by_cases h₁₁ : y = a
            · -- Case: x ≠ a and y = a
              have h₁₂ : g y = b := by simp [h₁₁]
              have h₁₃ : g x = if x = a' then f a else f x := by
                simp [h₁₀]
                <;> aesop
              have h₁₄ : (if x = a' then f a else f x) = b := by
                simp_all [h₁₂]
                <;> aesop
              by_cases h₁₅ : x = a'
              · -- Subcase: x = a'
                have h₁₆ : f a = b := by simp_all
                simp_all [h₁₅]
                <;> aesop
              · -- Subcase: x ≠ a'
                have h₁₆ : f x = b := by simp_all [h₁₅]
                have h₁₇ : f x = f a := by simp_all
                have h₁₈ : x = a := by
                  apply f.injective
                  simp_all
                simp_all
            · -- Case: x ≠ a and y ≠ a
              by_cases h₁₂ : x = a'
              · -- Subcase: x = a'
                by_cases h₁₃ : y = a'
                · -- Subcase: x = a' and y = a'
                  simp_all
                · -- Subcase: x = a' and y ≠ a'
                  have h₁₄ : g x = f a := by simp [h₁₂]
                  have h₁₅ : g y = if y = a' then f a else f y := by
                    simp [h₁₀, h₁₁]
                    <;> aesop
                  have h₁₆ : (if y = a' then f a else f y) = f a := by
                    simp_all [h₁₄]
                    <;> aesop
                  by_cases h₁₇ : y = a'
                  · simp_all
                  · have h₁₈ : f y = f a := by simp_all [h₁₇]
                    have h₁₉ : y = a' := by
                      apply f.injective
                      simp_all
                    simp_all
              · -- Subcase: x ≠ a'
                by_cases h₁₃ : y = a'
                · -- Subcase: x ≠ a' and y = a'
                  have h₁₄ : g y = f a := by simp [h₁₃]
                  have h₁₅ : g x = if x = a' then f a else f x := by
                    simp [h₁₀, h₁₁]
                    <;> aesop
                  have h₁₆ : (if x = a' then f a else f x) = f a := by
                    simp_all [h₁₄]
                    <;> aesop
                  by_cases h₁₇ : x = a'
                  · simp_all
                  · have h₁₈ : f x = f a := by simp_all [h₁₇]
                    have h₁₉ : x = a' := by
                      apply f.injective
                      simp_all
                    simp_all
                · -- Subcase: x ≠ a' and y ≠ a'
                  have h₁₄ : g x = f x := by
                    simp [h₁₀, h₁₂]
                    <;> aesop
                  have h₁₅ : g y = f y := by
                    simp [h₁₁, h₁₃]
                    <;> aesop
                  have h₁₆ : f x = f y := by simp_all
                  have h₁₇ : x = y := by
                    apply f.injective
                    simp_all
                  simp_all
        -- Construct the new embedding
        exact ⟨g, h₈⟩
    | inr h₄ =>
      -- Case 2: There does not exist an a' such that f a' = b
      -- We need to construct a new embedding that only changes the value of a
      have h₅ : ∀ (a' : α), f a' ≠ b := h₄
      let g : α → β := fun x => if x = a then b else f x
      -- Show that g is injective
      have h₆ : Function.Injective g := by
        intro x y h₇
        by_cases h₈ : x = a
        · by_cases h₉ : y = a
          · -- Case: x = a and y = a
            simp_all
          · -- Case: x = a and y ≠ a
            have h₁₀ : g x = b := by simp [h₈]
            have h₁₁ : g y = f y := by simp [h₉]
            have h₁₂ : f y = b := by simp_all
            have h₁₃ : f y ≠ b := h₅ y
            simp_all
        · by_cases h₉ : y = a
          · -- Case: x ≠ a and y = a
            have h₁₀ : g y = b := by simp [h₉]
            have h₁₁ : g x = f x := by simp [h₈]
            have h₁₂ : f x = b := by simp_all
            have h₁₃ : f x ≠ b := h₅ x
            simp_all
          · -- Case: x ≠ a and y ≠ a
            have h₁₀ : g x = f x := by simp [h₈]
            have h₁₁ : g y = f y := by simp [h₉]
            have h₁₂ : f x = f y := by simp_all
            have h₁₃ : x = y := by
              apply f.injective
              simp_all
            simp_all
      -- Construct the new embedding
      exact ⟨g, h₆⟩
